subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw expose `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in keyless Firecrawl search provider while Firecrawl's public docs still describe `/v2/search` as bearer-authenticated?
rationale: The code follows the existing opt-in provider pattern and a live no-auth request currently works, but the upstream no-auth search contract is undocumented and changes the privacy/support boundary for user search queries.

options.title: Require documented keyless contract
options.body: Do not merge the public provider until Firecrawl documents or otherwise confirms no-auth search, or an OpenClaw owner explicitly accepts the support risk.

options.title: Ship keyed improvements only
options.body: Remove `firecrawl-free` and keep the richer keyed `firecrawl_search` parameters as the bounded provider-owned improvement.

options.title: Accept opt-in free search now
options.body: Merge after resolving conflicts, treating the working live no-auth endpoint and explicit opt-in UX as sufficient despite the undocumented upstream contract.

recommendation.title: Require documented keyless contract
recommendation.body: Do not merge the public provider until Firecrawl documents or otherwise confirms no-auth search, or an OpenClaw owner explicitly accepts the support risk.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to both the merged Firecrawl keyless work and the adjacent key-free web-search policy, making them the best routing candidate for this boundary choice.
